name: Souda Kazuichi
source: When it comes to fixing machines, there's no one better than Kazuichi. He prides himself on his flashy appearance and cool demeanor, which makes it all the more surprising that he's actually a coward. Even minor incidents are enough to set him off and send him spiraling into a full-blown panic attack. Given this tendency to freak out at the drop of a hat, it's a mystery how he manages to stay so composed about his crush on Sonia.
